name: zgeometry_weiler_restore_output_z_from_input_plane
description: zGeometry_Weiler::RestoreOutputZFromInputPlane restores output point Z values from the input contour B plane.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL renders the final output-point z write through a post-increment alias and re-inlines the plane offset; assembly is the accepted behavior evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x469b60 validates edge01 and edge12 construction from inputContourB, cross-product plane normal calculation, planeNormal.z zero early return, normal normalization, plane offset calculation, output point count loop, and post-increment z write.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies Z restoration for points on a known plane and verifies the degenerate zero-normal-z path leaves output Z unchanged.
